compute_definition: integer process_time_ns and perf_counter_ns measured per step and episode
q_value_query_definition: one inspected tabular action value during greedy selection or bootstrap maximization; random exploration inspects zero values
safe_service_definition: Fraction of configured synthetic services not disabled. NASim 0.12.0 has no service-disable transition or availability state, so this is exactly 1.0 by environment construction.
